visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a blonde girl in a red Adidas crop top and black cargo pants standing in an outdoor pedestrian plaza with green trees. She holds a violin and its case, speaking energetically to the camera with high facial expressions. (2) The scene cuts to her interviewing a stall owner in an orange shirt and hat. They are at a market stall filled with jewelry and accessories; the girl holds a small microphone near the owner. (3) The girl plays her violin while looking at a smartphone held by the owner. A pink troll toy is attached to her violin. The owner listens attentively as they stand under a white market umbrella. (4) Transition to another stall where the girl talks to a man in a pink tank top and sunglasses. Racks of clothing are visible in the background against urban high-rise buildings. (5) The girl performs a song on her violin for the man, who smiles and nods. Yellow variety text and a digital record graphic are overlaid on the screen. (6) She moves to a ceramic stall, speaking with a woman in a white blouse. Neatly arranged bowls and pots are displayed on the table. The woman appears emotional, wiping a tear. (7) The final phase shows the girl celebrating with her arm raised, smiling broadly as she concludes the interviews in the busy market street.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-pitched, energetic female Mandarin voice shouting an introduction over an upbeat, medium-tempo pop track. Background urban chatter is audible. (2) A bright 'ding' SFX signals a transition to a conversational exchange between two women. The main speaker asks questions with a cheerful intonation. (3) A sudden musical shift occurs as a Japanese male vocal track plays briefly, followed by a live, bright violin melody performing the same tune. Female laughter is heard in the background. (4) A hard cut introduces a casual male voice speaking English with a moderate pitch. The female host responds in English with a playful, high-energy tone. (5) Another 'ding' SFX leads into a funky rhythmic track with bass, followed quickly by the live violin taking over the lead melody. (6) The mood shifts with a softer female voice and the live violin playing a slower, more sentimental minor-key piece. Soft sniffling and appreciative murmurs occur. (7) The final phase features loud cheering and the return of the upbeat intro music as the female speaker thanks the participants.
